svg.aria-label: Map of St Christina the Astonishing's places and churches, numbered: 1 Sint-Truiden, her town, with an inset showing the Church of Our Lady, the abbey tower, St Gangulf's, St Peter's, the Beguinage, and the railway station on the site of the convent of St Catherine, where she sang, died and was first buried; 2 Brustem, her birthplace by tradition; 3 Wellen, where she plunged into the baptismal font; 4 Borgloon, the castle of the counts of Loon, where she lived nine years; 5 Liège on the Meuse, with St Christopher's church; 6 Nonnenmielen, the abbey where her relics rested from 1231 to 1796. Tongeren and the battlefield of Steppes are also marked.

g.text: Sint-Truiden: her town, her convent, her tomb
Borgloon: the counts’ castle, nine years
Liège: St Christopher’s and the Meuse
